about.title: Nordic Tradition, Heart of the Coffee Region
about.subtitle: A culinary bridge between the fjords of Iceland and the lush green mountains of Dosquebradas in the Eje Cafetero
about.story1: Velmor was born in Dosquebradas, right in the heart of Colombia's Coffee Region (Eje Cafetero), when our master dairy artisan discovered the secret of Skyr in Iceland: a Viking superfood with over a thousand years of history, extraordinarily rich in protein and creaminess.
about.story2: In our artisanal dairy farms across the Eje Cafetero, we perfected the ancestral recipe using fresh milk from certified mountain pastures and sun-ripened fruits harvested at dawn by local farmers in Risaralda.
about.value1Desc: Fresh free-range milk from artisanal farms in Dosquebradas and the Eje Cafetero, with zero hormones, thickeners, or artificial preservatives.
about.value2Desc: Traditional slow straining and controlled fermentation using authentic Icelandic cultures.
about.value3Desc: Returnable and recyclable packaging, fair trade with Eje Cafetero farmers, and a low carbon footprint.
about.value4Desc: Up to 3x more protein than regular yogurt and millions of live active probiotics.
about.certDesc: Backed by INVIMA health registration, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and sustainable dairy certification in Dosquebradas and the Eje Cafetero.

faqs.q: How is Velmor Skyr different from Greek or regular yogurt?
faqs.a: Skyr is crafted with 4 times more fresh Eje Cafetero milk than regular yogurt and undergoes a traditional Nordic straining process that removes almost all fat and sour whey, delivering up to 15g of protein per serving with a much denser, velvety texture.

faqs.q: How long does the product last in the fridge?
faqs.a: Because it is 100% natural with zero artificial preservatives, our Skyr has a shelf life of 25 days when kept constantly refrigerated between 2°C and 5°C. Once opened, we recommend consuming it within 7 days.

faqs.q: Do you deliver across Dosquebradas and the Coffee Region?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer 24-hour refrigerated delivery across Dosquebradas, Pereira, Santa Rosa de Cabal, and the main municipalities of the Eje Cafetero. Shipping is free on orders over $50,000 COP.

faqs.q: How do the delivery details form and WhatsApp checkout work?
faqs.a: Simply add your favorite products to the cart, click 'Enter Delivery Details', fill in your address in Dosquebradas or the Eje Cafetero, and press 'Send Order via WhatsApp'. A clean, itemized order summary will be generated automatically.

faqs.q: Do your products contain added sugar or lactose?
faqs.a: Our products contain zero refined added sugars; their gentle sweetness comes exclusively from real fruit. Furthermore, the slow Skyr fermentation process significantly reduces lactose content.
